items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: she took me down to her lawyer... we came to terms, and so I started writing her music, writing the show.

ctx.x: Who was Pete Nugent? He was a dancer, wasn't he?
Pete Nugent was a dancer, yeah. He was with the show, Norma Miller's show. We used to buddy around together. And we went from --
There must have been prostitution all over that place.
